# Waste App

**This cross-platform app was generated by [Briefcase](https://briefcase.beeware.org/) - part of
[The BeeWare Project](https://beeware.org/).**

An app built to track trash days at my house for my android device. 
Calendar view with trash type highlighted in a designated colour. 
Sends a notification at 2pm the day before collection to remind me to take out the bins.

# Features:
The main window displays the calendar with the current month selected and the current day highlighted in blue. Above collection days is a colour bar indicating its a collection day and which trash types are being collected.
![alt text](https://github.com/cos-glitch/waste_app/tree/main/wasteapp/images_for_github/calendar_view.jpg "Calendar view")

Selecting a day with collection highlights the selected day anbd a list of trash types to be collected that day appears below the calendar view.
